notes.note: Solid for Perez and this is about what you would expect to get from him most weeks.
Perez came back into the side but he will find it hard to hold his spot on the back of his 9 possession game. He isn't one you can rely on.
Perez was back to the sort of score we saw when he was in the team earlier in the season. His value rose and his BE dropped to 32 which helps us hold him.
Perez was a late in but managed just the 9 disposals whilst giving away 4 free kicks. He rose in value thanks to that negative BE but now has one of 21.
Flynn Perez was dropped this week so we couldn't capitalise on his negative break even.
Perez had his lowest of the season but only just. He has been hanging around the 50s to 60s. His BE remains negative meaning you could still get him this week if you are in need of a def downgrade.
